title: Al-Qadr 97:4-5 with words spaced, and the questions
subject: Qur'an & Tajweed
unit: Spring 1: Al-Qadr, Al-'Alaq 1 to 12 and the noon sakinah rules
source: Written for quran/y3 lesson 11 (Pupil PDF worksheet: Al-Qadr 97:4-5 with words spaced, and the questions)
intro: Lesson 11. Read each word slowly, pointing with your finger. Only the Arabic is the Qur'an; the English is a translation of its meaning.

arabic.text: تَنَزَّلُ ٱلْمَلَٰٓئِكَةُ وَٱلرُّوحُ فِيهَا بِإِذْنِ رَبِّهِم مِّن كُلِّ أَمْرٍۢ (٤) سَلَٰمٌ هِىَ حَتَّىٰ مَطْلَعِ ٱلْفَجْرِ (٥)

head: Ayah
Translation of the meaning (Saheeh International)
rows: The angels and the Spirit descend therein by permission of their Lord for every matter.
Peace it is until the emergence of dawn.

head: Word
Where
Rule
How to read it
rows: Light hidden noon with a hum
Merge the meems with a hum (Year 3 Spring 2)
The ط has sukoon, so it bounces

questions.q: Chunk and link Al-Qadr 97:4-5 together, ayah by ayah.
questions.a: The class recites 97:4-5 together without the mushaf.

questions.q: Listening rota: today's group recites 97:4-5 to the teacher, one by one. Everyone else: 3-3-link the same ayat, then tick the revision log.
questions.a: Pupil recites with no help; the teacher marks hifdh and tajweed on the rubric and gives one target.

questions.q: Recite all of Al-Qadr (97:1 to 5) to a partner in a breakout room; your partner ticks each ayah.
questions.a: All five ayat in order with no prompts.

questions.q: Which word in 97:5 has a qalqalah letter with sukoon? Read it with a bounce.
questions.a: مَطْلَعِ: the ط has sukoon, so it bounces.

questions.q: Who comes down on the Night of Decree, by Allah's permission?
questions.a: A) The angels and the Ruh (Jibril). 97:4: the angels and the Ruh come down by the permission of their Lord. The other answers are not in the surah.

questions.q: Al-Qadr 97:4: «تَنَزَّلُ ٱلْمَلَٰٓئِكَةُ ...» Which word comes next?
Think again: What does 'peace until dawn' make you think of? How could a night be full of peace?
questions.a: Allah says the night is peace until the rising of dawn (97:5); the angels come down by Allah's permission (97:4).
